PHASES = [
    ("pilot", 25),
    ("engineering", 150),
    ("company_wide", 825),
]

def plan_rollout(phases):
    lines = []
    total = 0
    for name, seats in phases:
        total += seats
        lines.append(f"{name}: {seats} seats (total {total})")
    return lines

for line in plan_rollout(PHASES):
    print(line)
print(f"rollout_complete={sum(seats for _, seats in PHASES)}")
